description: Project scaffold: package.json, Vite/TS/Tailwind config, index.html, global CSS, types, utilities, Supabase migration SQL, data layer abstraction, seed data, and Auth context. This is the foundation every other FEAT depends on.
steps: 1. Create package.json at workspace root with all pinned dependencies exactly as specified: react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1, react-router-dom@6.26.2, @supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4, tailwindcss@3.4.13, autoprefixer@10.4.20, postcss@8.4.47, recharts@2.12.7, lucide-react@0.447.0, react-hook-form@7.53.0, zod@3.23.8, date-fns@4.1.0, papaparse@5.4.1, @types/papaparse@5.3.14, jspdf@2.5.2, jspdf-autotable@3.8.3, zustand@5.0.0, clsx@2.1.1, tailwind-merge@2.5.3. Dev deps: vite@5.4.8, @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.2, typescript@5.6.2, @types/react@18.3.11, @types/react-dom@18.3.1. Scripts: dev, build, preview.
3. Create tsconfig.json: target ES2020, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, strict true, jsx react-jsx, paths {'@/*': ['./src/*']}.
4. Create tsconfig.node.json for vite config files.

5. Create tailwind.config.ts: content ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], extend theme with brand colors (primary #6366f1, success #10b981, warning #f59e0b, danger #ef4444, info #3b82f6), fontFamily sans with 'Inter' prepended.
6. Create postcss.config.js: plugins tailwindcss and autoprefixer.

7. Create index.html: charset UTF-8, viewport mobile-optimized, title 'Co.Muneeb — Your Kirana Business, Clearly', link Google Fonts Inter (400,500,600,700), favicon /favicon.svg, div#root, script type=module src=/src/main.tsx.
8. Create public/favicon.svg: a simple SVG with a shopping bag or store icon in indigo (#6366f1), 32x32.
9. Create src/vite-env.d.ts: /// <reference types='vite/client' /> plus interface ImportMetaEnv with VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

10. Create src/index.css: @tailwind base/components/utilities directives. Set body font-family Inter. Custom scrollbar styles. CSS variables for brand colors. Utility class .rupee for currency display.

11. Create src/types/index.ts: Export TypeScript interfaces for ALL entities — Store, Category, Product, Customer, Supplier, Sale, SaleItem, Purchase, PurchaseItem, CustomerTransaction, SupplierTransaction, Expense, InventoryMovement, DashboardStats, InsightAlert. Include all fields from the prompt spec. Use string UUIDs for ids. Include PaymentMethod = 'cash' | 'upi' | 'credit' union. Include TransactionType = 'debit' | 'credit' union.
12. Create src/lib/supabase.ts: createClient only when VITE_SUPABASE_URL is set, else export null. Export isSupabaseConfigured() helper.

13. Create src/lib/utils.ts: formatCurrency(n: number) using Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {style:'currency', currency:'INR', maximumFractionDigits:0}). formatDate(d: string|Date). cn(...classes) using clsx+tailwind-merge. generateId() using crypto.randomUUID(). calcWeightedAvgCost(batches: {qty, price}[]) returns weighted average. calcDaysRemaining(stock: number, unitsSoldLast30: number) returns number. isDeadStock(lastSaleDate: string|null, thresholdDays=30) returns boolean.

14. Create src/data/seedData.ts: 90 days of realistic demo data. PRODUCTS (10): Rice (category: Grains, SKU: RICE001, unit: kg, purchasePrice: 45, sellingPrice: 55, stock: 150, minStock: 50, supplier: Agarwal Traders), Wheat (Grains, WHT001, kg, 28, 35, 200, 50, Agarwal Traders), Sugar (Essentials, SUG001, kg, 38, 45, 100, 30, Sharma Wholesale), Mustard Oil (Oils, OIL001, ltr, 120, 145, 60, 20, Sharma Wholesale), Parle-G Biscuits (Snacks, BISK001, pkt, 8, 10, 300, 100, Kumar Distributors), Maggi Noodles (Snacks, MAG001, pkt, 12, 15, 200, 80, Kumar Distributors), Lux Soap (Personal Care, SOAP001, bar, 35, 42, 120, 40, Kumar Distributors), Clinic Plus Shampoo (Personal Care, SHMP001, btl, 65, 80, 80, 25, Kumar Distributors), Tata Tea (Beverages, TEA001, pkt, 95, 115, 90, 30, Agarwal Traders), Salt (Essentials, SALT001, kg, 15, 20, 200, 60, Sharma Wholesale). CUSTOMERS (5): Ramesh Kumar (mob: 9876543210), Priya Sharma (9876543211), Abdul Rehman (9876543212), Sunita Devi (9876543213), Mohan Singh (9876543214). SUPPLIERS (3): Agarwal Traders (contact: Vijay Agarwal, mob: 9876541001), Sharma Wholesale (contact: Rakesh Sharma, mob: 9876541002), Kumar Distributors (contact: Suresh Kumar, mob: 9876541003). SALES: generate 3-8 random sales per day for 90 days using these products and customers, mix of cash/upi/credit. PURCHASES: 2-4 per week for 90 days. EXPENSES: monthly rent (₹8000), electricity (₹2000-3500 varies), miscellaneous (₹500-2000 weekly). All data uses deterministic random (seeded) so it's reproducible. Export as: seedProducts, seedCategories, seedCustomers, seedSuppliers, seedSales, seedSaleItems, seedPurchases, seedPurchaseItems, seedCustomerTransactions, seedSupplierTransactions, seedExpenses.

15. Create src/lib/dataLayer.ts: Define interface IDataLayer with async methods: getProducts(), addProduct(p), updateProduct(id, p), deleteProduct(id), getSales(from?, to?), addSale(s, items[]), getPurchases(from?, to?), addPurchase(p, items[]), getCustomers(), addCustomer(c), updateCustomer(id, c), getCustomerTransactions(customerId), addCustomerTransaction(t), getSuppliers(), addSupplier(s), updateSupplier(id, s), getSupplierTransactions(supplierId), addSupplierTransaction(t), getExpenses(from?, to?), addExpense(e), getDashboardStats(), getCategories(). Implement LocalDataLayer: uses localStorage keys prefixed 'comunib_'. On first instantiation when localStorage is empty, calls initWithSeedData() which loads seedData.ts into localStorage. Implement SupabaseDataLayer using @supabase/supabase-js queries against the schema defined in FEAT-001 step 16. Export getDataLayer(): IDataLayer which returns LocalDataLayer when !isSupabaseConfigured(), else SupabaseDataLayer singleton.

16. Create supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql: Full PostgreSQL schema. Tables: stores (id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), owner_id uuid references auth.users, name text, created_at timestamptz default now()), categories (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK stores, name text, color text, icon text), products (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, category_id uuid FK categories, name text NOT NULL, sku text, brand text, unit text NOT NULL, purchase_price numeric(10,2) NOT NULL, selling_price numeric(10,2) NOT NULL, current_stock numeric(10,3) default 0, min_stock_level numeric(10,3) default 0, supplier_id uuid FK suppliers, expiry_date date, created_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz), customers (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, name text NOT NULL, mobile text, address text, opening_balance numeric(10,2) default 0, current_balance numeric(10,2) default 0, due_date date, notes text, created_at timestamptz), suppliers (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, name text NOT NULL, contact_person text, mobile text, address text, opening_balance numeric(10,2) default 0, current_balance numeric(10,2) default 0, due_date date, notes text, created_at timestamptz), sales (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, customer_id uuid FK customers nullable, sale_date date NOT NULL, total_amount numeric(10,2), discount numeric(10,2) default 0, payment_method text CHECK IN ('cash','upi','credit'), notes text, created_at timestamptz), sale_items (id uuid PK, sale_id uuid FK sales, product_id uuid FK products, quantity numeric(10,3), unit_price numeric(10,2), cost_price numeric(10,2), total_price numeric(10,2)), purchases (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, supplier_id uuid FK suppliers nullable, purchase_date date NOT NULL, total_amount numeric(10,2), payment_status text CHECK IN ('paid','credit','partial'), notes text, created_at timestamptz), purchase_items (id uuid PK, purchase_id uuid FK purchases, product_id uuid FK products, quantity numeric(10,3), unit_price numeric(10,2), total_price numeric(10,2)), customer_transactions (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, customer_id uuid FK customers, transaction_date date, description text, debit_amount numeric(10,2) default 0, credit_amount numeric(10,2) default 0, balance numeric(10,2), transaction_type text, reference_id uuid), supplier_transactions (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, supplier_id uuid FK suppliers, transaction_date date, description text, debit_amount numeric(10,2) default 0, credit_amount numeric(10,2) default 0, balance numeric(10,2), transaction_type text, reference_id uuid), expenses (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, expense_date date NOT NULL, category text NOT NULL, description text, amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL, payment_method text, created_at timestamptz), inventory_movements (id uuid PK, store_id uuid FK, product_id uuid FK products, movement_date timestamptz, movement_type text CHECK IN ('sale','purchase','adjustment'), quantity_change numeric(10,3), reference_id uuid, notes text). RLS: Enable RLS on all tables. Policy pattern: 'Users can only access their own store data' using store_id = get_user_store_id(). Function get_user_store_id() returns uuid: SELECT id FROM stores WHERE owner_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1. Trigger on auth.users INSERT: creates a store named 'My Store' for the new user.
17. Create .env.example: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=your_project_url, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your_anon_key (with comment: leave blank for demo mode).
18. Run `npm install` to install all dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors and zero Vite build errors

src/types/index.ts exports all required interfaces: Store, Category, Product, Customer, Supplier, Sale, SaleItem, Purchase, PurchaseItem, CustomerTransaction, SupplierTransaction, Expense, InventoryMovement, DashboardStats, InsightAlert, PaymentMethod, TransactionType
src/lib/dataLayer.ts exports getDataLayer() and IDataLayer interface
src/data/seedData.ts exports 10 products, 5 customers, 3 suppliers, and 90 days of transactions
supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql contains CREATE TABLE for all 13 required tables plus RLS policies
